title: HealthSmart 500 mL Essential Oil Diffuser — White

comparisons.notes: White, large 500 mL. Sold and shipped by DermiLA Market LLC; available with free delivery when checked.

writeup: This white 500 mL diffuser includes adjustable mist and timer settings, making it a low-cost option if you already use an essential-oil diffuser. At $3.99, Woot is 80% below the matching large white model offered on Walmart Marketplace at the time checked. The comparison uses the available seller price rather than Woot’s reference price; oils are sold separately.
notes: Woot lists a 90-day limited warranty. Prime members get free standard shipping; other shipping charges can substantially change the savings on a low-priced item. Follow the product instructions and check whether your chosen oils are suitable for your household.
amazon_match_notes: White 500 mL diffuser, pack of one.
